newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin chooses Salomon Bros for IPB tender.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin chooses Salomon Bros for IPB tender.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry on Wednesday said it had chosen U.S.-investment bank Salomon Bros to arrange the sale of the state's stake in bank IPB a.s..
The state holds a 31.5 percent through the state privatisaiton agency, the National Property Fund, and an additional 4.45 percent through the state-owned Ceska Posta s.p..

"On the basis of the contract, the financial advisor will assist the Finance Ministry and the NPF in organising the tender including consideration of individual bids," the ministry said in a statement.
The IPB stake sell-off is the first step in the government's aim to fully privatise its stakes in the four largest Czech banks, although plans for the other three have yet to be agreed.
A special committee has been formed at the Finance Ministry to prepare the sale, which is expected to be geared toward choosing a strong foreign partner.
NPF chairman Roman Ceska, who does not have a seat in the cabinet which must approve the sale, has said Japanese investment bank Nomura has the "best chance" to win the tender.
Czech media have also said Dutch ING Groep NV and ABN AMRO as parties are interested in taking a stake in IPB, although both have refused to comment on the matter.
